classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 0.11% of the pixels differ by more than 3 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box (flat fills, because Chromium dithers gradients). It covers -webkit-mask-box-image with slices, fill (the shorthand fills the middle by itself, the slice longhand does not), repeat, round with an outset, a gradient source, width auto, the longhands, and a mask layer under it. With the box image ignored the same fixture measures 39.01%, so it fails.
